L34: cite5†mothercare plc†www.mothercareplc.com L35: # welcome to mothercare global brand
L36: 
L37: Founded in the UK in 1961, mothercare was created with a simple purpose: to support families through every stage of the parenting journey.
L38: Today, mothercare is a trusted global parenting brand, supporting families across 21 markets with thoughtfully designed products, expert advice, and decades of experience. From newborn essentials and first outfits to pushchairs, toys and nursery must-haves, every product is designed with comfort, safety and practicality at its core.
L39: But mothercare is about more than products. We’re here for the milestone moments, the everyday routines and the questions parents ask along the way, offering support, reassurance and trusted expertise from first days to first steps, and beyond.

L145: 
L146: Play is how little ones make sense of the world. Every reach, roll, stack and smile helps build confidence, coordination and curiosity. From toys that inspire imagination to essentials designed for active exploring, we make it easier to support every stage of learning through play.

L150: cite36†Image: baby mealtimes†framerusercontent.com L151: ### it’s in our nature to nurture
L152: 
L153: From breastfeeding, first bottles and weaning, to family mealtimes, feeding is a journey that constantly evolves. That's why we've created products that make every stage simpler, alongside expert guidance to help parents feel confident every step of the way.
L154: ### and now for bed…
L155: 
L156: A good night's sleep looks different for every family. Each stage has its own rhythms, needs and milestones. We make bedtime simpler with safe sleep solutions, advice, and products designed for every stage. Because when little ones sleep well, parents can too.
